#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Story 12 — execution-realism rerun of September 2015 (then October–November) with the
# reference plan from strategies/baseline/config.yaml: risk-based lots, stop and
# target orders, trailing stop, partial close, 1-pip spread, $10,000 account.
# Frozen 2026-09-26 models; the chain strategies now take only --param cash.
set -euo pipefail
SUITE=${SUITE:-/tmp/mba-story12/algo-suite}
JOB=/home/wellington/workspace/mba-agents/mba-main/algo-suite/data/training/2026-09-27-execution-realism
PILOT=/home/wellington/workspace/mba-agents/mba-main/algo-suite/data/training/2026-09-26-six-month-pilot
SUITE_DATA=/home/wellington/workspace/mba-agents/mba-main/algo-suite/data
export ALGO_DATA_ROOT="$PILOT/data"
export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 ALGO_BROKER__ADAPTER=oanda OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=4 LOKY_MAX_CPU_COUNT=4
cd "$SUITE"
exec 9>"$JOB/run.lock"; flock -n 9 || exit 1
trap 'code=$?; printf "exit_code=%s finished=%s\n" "$code" "$(date -Iseconds)" > "$JOB/exit-status.txt"' EXIT
stage() { printf '%s %s\n' "$(date -Iseconds)" "$1" | tee "$JOB/status.txt"; }
sha256sum "$PILOT/baseline-f7.json" "$PILOT/hybrid-f7.json" > "$JOB/model-hashes.txt"
git -C "$SUITE" rev-parse HEAD > "$JOB/git-revision.txt"; git -C "$SUITE" status --short >> "$JOB/git-revision.txt"
# October–December canonical event months into the pilot data root (completed .done only),
# then event features for 2015-10-01..2015-12-01 so the November hybrid run has its last
# bar's decision minute (2015-12-01 00:00 UTC) covered.
stage link-event-months
for month in 10 11 12; do
  source_dir="$SUITE_DATA/parquet/events/gdelt/year=2015/month=$month"
  test -f "$source_dir/.done"
  ln -sfn "$source_dir" "$ALGO_DATA_ROOT/parquet/events/gdelt/year=2015/month=$month"
done
stage build-event-features-oct-nov
uv run algo-score events --kind gdelt --from 2015-10-01 --to 2015-12-01 > "$JOB/event-features.log" 2>&1
uv run algo-backtest explain-strategy baseline > "$JOB/baseline-parameters.txt"
uv run algo-backtest explain-strategy hybrid > "$JOB/hybrid-parameters.txt"
for window in "2015-09-01 2015-09-30" "2015-10-01 2015-10-31" "2015-11-01 2015-11-30"; do
  set -- $window; from=$1; to=$2; tag=${from:0:7}
  for strategy in baseline hybrid; do
    stage "$strategy-$tag"
    uv run algo-backtest run --strategy $strategy --symbol EURUSD --from $from --to $to \
      --param cash=10000 --model "$PILOT/$strategy-f7.json" --timeout 14400 \
      > "$JOB/$strategy-$tag.log" 2>&1
  done
done
stage complete

calibrate_thresholds.py.text:
"""Threshold calibration for F7 on the July-2015 validation span (and Aug held-out, for reference).

Uses the frozen pilot models; never touches September.
"""
import json
import sys
from datetime import date
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from algo_backtest.chain.filters.f7_meta_learner import walk_forward_split
from algo_backtest.chain.filters.f7_model_io import load_model
from algo_backtest.strategies import load_strategy_chain_config
from algo_backtest.training import build_training_rows, load_event_intensity, load_m1_bars
from algo_core import layout
from algo_core.instrument import build_instrument

import os
JOB = Path(os.environ["CALIB_JOB"])
data_root = layout.data_root()
instrument = build_instrument("EURUSD")
start, train_end, val_end, test_end = date(2015, 3, 2), date(2015, 12, 31), date(2016, 1, 31), date(2016, 2, 29)
bars = load_m1_bars(data_root, instrument, start, test_end)
intensity = load_event_intensity(data_root, start, test_end)
config = load_strategy_chain_config("baseline")
assert config.f7 is not None
rows = build_training_rows(
    bars, intensity, perception=config.perception, price_features_config=config.price_features,
    horizon_minutes=config.f7.label_horizon_minutes, instrument=instrument,
)
split = walk_forward_split(rows, train_end=train_end, validation_end=val_end, test_end=test_end)
GRID = [(0.55, 0.45), (0.56, 0.44), (0.57, 0.43), (0.58, 0.42), (0.54, 0.46), (0.53, 0.47), (0.52, 0.48), (0.51, 0.49)]
out = {}
for name in ("baseline", "hybrid"):
    model = load_model(JOB / f"{name}-f7.json")
    for span_name, span in (("validation_jan2016", split.validation), ("heldout_feb2016", split.test)):
        p = np.array([model.predict(r.features) for r in span])
        y = np.array([r.label for r in span])
        regime = np.sign(np.array([float(r.features["trend_direction"]) for r in span]))
        rec = {
            "rows": int(len(span)),
            "p_quantiles": {q: round(float(np.quantile(p, q)), 4) for q in (0.01, 0.05, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.95, 0.99)},
            "p_by_regime": {
                lab: {"n": int((regime == v).sum()), "p_mean": round(float(p[regime == v].mean()), 4) if (regime == v).any() else None}
                for lab, v in (("bull", 1), ("bear", -1), ("neutral", 0))
            },
            "grid": [],
        }
        for hi, lo in GRID:
            for gate in (True, False):
                buy = p > hi
                sell = p < lo
                if gate:
                    buy &= regime == 1
                    sell &= regime == -1
                n_buy, n_sell = int(buy.sum()), int(sell.sum())
                hit_buy = round(float(y[buy].mean()), 3) if n_buy else None
                hit_sell = round(float(1 - y[sell].mean()), 3) if n_sell else None
                signals = n_buy + n_sell
                hits = (y[buy] == 1).sum() + (y[sell] == 0).sum()
                rec["grid"].append({
                    "theta_high": hi, "theta_low": lo, "regime_gate": gate,
                    "n_buy": n_buy, "n_sell": n_sell, "hit_buy": hit_buy, "hit_sell": hit_sell,
                    "hit_all": round(float(hits / signals), 3) if signals else None,
                    "signal_share": round(signals / len(span), 4),
                })
        out[f"{name}/{span_name}"] = rec
        print(name, span_name, "done", file=sys.stderr)
Path(sys.argv[1]).write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=1))
print("written", sys.argv[1])

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Story 12 main experiment — one-year training protocol (registered 2026-09-27 with the user):
#   family fitting     2015-03-02 .. 2015-12-31  (GDELT 2.0 collection starts 2015-02-18; March is the first full month)
#   combiner calibration 2016-01-01 .. 2016-01-31   (thresholds checked here, before simulation)
#   held-out partition 2016-02-01 .. 2016-02-29   (trainer only, no replay)
#   simulation         2016-03-01 .. 2016-10-31   one continuous run per strategy, $10,000, reference plan
#   (October 2016 finished ingesting 2026-09-27 evening and was added before the job's first stage completed)
# Isolated data root: completed canonical GDELT months 2015-03..2016-10 linked in, own features.
set -euo pipefail
SUITE=${SUITE:-/tmp/mba-story12/algo-suite}
SUITE_DATA=/home/wellington/workspace/mba-agents/mba-main/algo-suite/data
JOB=/home/wellington/workspace/mba-agents/mba-main/algo-suite/data/training/2026-09-28-one-year-protocol
export ALGO_DATA_ROOT="$JOB/data"
export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 ALGO_BROKER__ADAPTER=oanda OMP_NUM_THREADS=6 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=6 LOKY_MAX_CPU_COUNT=6
cd "$SUITE"
exec 9>"$JOB/run.lock"; flock -n 9 || exit 1
trap 'code=$?; printf "exit_code=%s finished=%s\n" "$code" "$(date -Iseconds)" > "$JOB/exit-status.txt"' EXIT
stage() { printf '%s %s\n' "$(date -Iseconds)" "$1" | tee "$JOB/status.txt"; }

stage link-data
mkdir -p "$ALGO_DATA_ROOT/parquet/events/gdelt/year=2015" "$ALGO_DATA_ROOT/parquet/events/gdelt/year=2016"
ln -sfn "$SUITE_DATA/parquet/forex" "$ALGO_DATA_ROOT/parquet/forex"
ln -sfn "$SUITE_DATA/lean-data" "$ALGO_DATA_ROOT/lean-data"
for ym in 2015-03 2015-04 2015-05 2015-06 2015-07 2015-08 2015-09 2015-10 2015-11 2015-12 \
          2016-01 2016-02 2016-03 2016-04 2016-05 2016-06 2016-07 2016-08 2016-09 2016-10; do
  y=${ym%-*}; m=${ym#*-}
  source_dir="$SUITE_DATA/parquet/events/gdelt/year=$y/month=$m"
  test -f "$source_dir/.done"
  ln -sfn "$source_dir" "$ALGO_DATA_ROOT/parquet/events/gdelt/year=$y/month=$m"
done
git -C "$SUITE" rev-parse HEAD > "$JOB/git-revision.txt"; git -C "$SUITE" status --short >> "$JOB/git-revision.txt"

stage build-event-features
# Through 2016-11-01 so the last October bar's decision minute (2016-11-01 00:00 UTC) is covered;
# month 2016-11 is a partial feature partition (one minute of 2016-11-01), never a training input.
uv run algo-score events --kind gdelt --from 2015-03-01 --to 2016-11-01 > "$JOB/event-features.log" 2>&1

stage train-baseline+hybrid
uv run python algo-backtest/scripts/train_baseline_meta_learner.py --symbol EURUSD \
  --from 2015-03-02 --train-end 2015-12-31 --validation-end 2016-01-31 --test-end 2016-02-29 \
  --out "$JOB/baseline-f7.json" > "$JOB/baseline-training.log" 2>&1 &
uv run python algo-backtest/scripts/train_hybrid_meta_learner.py --symbol EURUSD \
  --from 2015-03-02 --train-end 2015-12-31 --validation-end 2016-01-31 --test-end 2016-02-29 \
  --out "$JOB/hybrid-f7.json" > "$JOB/hybrid-training.log" 2>&1 &
wait
sha256sum "$JOB/baseline-f7.json" "$JOB/hybrid-f7.json" > "$JOB/model-hashes.txt"
uv run algo-backtest explain-strategy baseline > "$JOB/baseline-parameters.txt"
uv run algo-backtest explain-strategy hybrid > "$JOB/hybrid-parameters.txt"

stage calibrate-thresholds-jan2016
# Pre-registered rule: keep theta 0.55/0.45 with the gate off unless the January-2016 validation
# hit rate at 0.55/0.45 is below 0.5; the grid is recorded either way and never uses 2016 data.
CALIB_JOB="$JOB" uv run python "$JOB/calibrate_thresholds.py" "$JOB/threshold-calibration.json" > "$JOB/calibration.log" 2>&1

stage "baseline+hybrid-2016-03..10"
for strategy in baseline hybrid; do
  uv run algo-backtest run --strategy $strategy --symbol EURUSD --from 2016-03-01 --to 2016-10-31 \
    --param cash=10000 --model "$JOB/$strategy-f7.json" --timeout 43200 \
    > "$JOB/$strategy-simulation.log" 2>&1 &
done
wait
stage complete
